ratios.covenant_name: Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio ("CTNL Ratio")
ratios.quote: According to the provisions of the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, we are required to maintain a maximum CTNL Ratio of 3.00 to 1.00 and a minimum CIC ratio of 3.00 to 1.00, with the provision that the maximum CTNL Ratio can be temporarily increased to 3.50 to 1.00 upon the occurrence of a Qualified Acquisition (as defined in, and subject to the requirements of the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement).

According to the provisions of the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, we are required to maintain a maximum CTNL Ratio of 3.00 to 1.00 and a minimum CIC ratio of 3.00 to 1.00, with the provision that the maximum CTNL Ratio can be temporarily increased to 3.50 to 1.00 upon the occurrence of a Qualified Acquisition (as defined in, and subject to the requirements of the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement).

parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed; the company states only that it was fully in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The maximum CTNL Ratio can temporarily step up to 3.50x after a Qualified Acquisition. The total net leverage ratio is also used to set the SOFR and base-rate pricing spreads; that pricing use is not a separate covenant and is not reported here.
